```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
```


```{r}
flu_sero <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Capstone Data/Flu Vaccine Serology and HAI/sound-life_flu_serology_single.csv")
flu_hai  <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Capstone Data/Flu Vaccine Serology and HAI/sound-life_flu_hai_single.csv")
flu_meta <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Capstone Data/Flu Vaccine Serology and HAI/sound-life_flu-vaccine_antigen_metadata.csv")
```

```{r}
glimpse(flu_sero)
glimpse(flu_hai)

names(flu_sero)
names(flu_hai)
```


```{r}
flu_sero |> count(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit, vaccine.year)
flu_hai  |> count(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit, vaccine.year)

# antigen panels
flu_sero |> count(msd.antigenName)
flu_hai  |> count(msd.antigenName)

summary(flu_sero$msd.concPercentCV)
summary(flu_hai$msd.signalNormPercentCV)

# subject counts
n_distinct(flu_sero$subject.subjectGuid)
n_distinct(flu_hai$subject.subjectGuid)
```

```{r}
# forcing guids to character
flu_sero <- flu_sero |> mutate(across(contains("Guid"), as.character))
flu_hai  <- flu_hai  |> mutate(across(contains("Guid"), as.character))
```


```{r}
# filter to flu year 1
sero_y1 <- flu_sero |>
  filter(
    vaccine.year == "2020-2021",
    sample.daysSinceFirstVisit %in% c(0, 6, 7, 8, 9)
  )

cat("Serology Year 1 rows:", nrow(sero_y1), "\n")
cat("Subjects:", n_distinct(sero_y1$subject.subjectGuid), "\n")
```

```{r}
# CV greater than 20%
sero_y1 <- sero_y1 |>
  mutate(igg_cv_flag = case_when(
    is.na(msd.concPercentCV) ~ NA,
    msd.concPercentCV > 20   ~ TRUE,
    TRUE                    ~ FALSE
  ))

cat("IgG CV flags (>20%):", sum(sero_y1$igg_cv_flag == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```


```{r}
sero_y1 |> 
  filter(igg_cv_flag == TRUE)
```

```{r}
# addressing multiple post-vaccine timepoints per subject x antigen by keeping earliest timepoint

sero_pre <- sero_y1 |> filter(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit == 0)

sero_post <- sero_y1 |>
  filter(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit != 0) |>
  group_by(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid, msd.antigenName) |>
  arrange(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup()

cat("Pre-vaccine subjects:", n_distinct(sero_pre$subject.subjectGuid), "\n")
cat("Post-vaccine subjects:", n_distinct(sero_post$subject.subjectGuid), "\n")
```


```{r}
# Check no duplicate subject x antigen before pivot
sero_pre_clean <- sero_pre_clean |>
  distinct(subject.subjectGuid,
           sample.sampleKitGuid,
           .keep_all = TRUE)

sero_pre_clean <- sero_pre |>
  group_by(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid, msd.antigenName) |>
  summarise(
    msd.concMean = first(msd.concMean),
    igg_cv_flag  = first(igg_cv_flag),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sero_post_clean <- sero_post |>
  distinct(subject.subjectGuid,
           sample.sampleKitGuid,
           msd.antigenName,
           .keep_all = TRUE)

sero_post_clean <- sero_post |>
  group_by(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid, msd.antigenName) |>
  summarise(
    msd.concMean = first(msd.concMean),
    igg_cv_flag  = first(igg_cv_flag),
    sample.daysSinceFirstVisit = first(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```


```{r}
sero_post |>
  filter(subject.subjectGuid == "BR2041",
         msd.antigenName == "B/Phuket")
```


```{r}
sero_pre_wide <- sero_pre_clean |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid),
    names_from = msd.antigenName,
    values_from = c(msd.concMean, igg_cv_flag),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{msd.antigenName}",
    values_fn = first
  ) |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("val.igg_d0_", str_remove(.x, "msd_conc_mean_")),
              .cols = starts_with("msd_conc_mean_")) |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("val.igg_cv_flag_d0_", str_remove(.x, "igg_cv_flag_")),
              .cols = starts_with("igg_cv_flag_"))

sero_post_wide <- sero_post_clean |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid),
    names_from = msd.antigenName,
    values_from = c(msd.concMean, igg_cv_flag),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{msd.antigenName}",
    values_fn = first
  ) |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("val.igg_d7_", str_remove(.x, "msd_conc_mean_")),
              .cols = starts_with("msd_conc_mean_")) |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("val.igg_cv_flag_d7_", str_remove(.x, "igg_cv_flag_")),
              .cols = starts_with("igg_cv_flag_"))

cat("sero_pre_wide rows: ", nrow(sero_pre_wide), "\n")
cat("sero_post_wide rows:", nrow(sero_post_wide), "\n")
```


```{r}
# joining pre and post on subject
sero_wide <- sero_pre_wide |>
  full_join(
    sero_post_wide,
    by = c("subject_subject_guid", "sample_sample_kit_guid")
  )

# cleaning antigen names
antigens_sero <- c("a_brisbane","a_hong_kong","a_michigan",
                   "a_victoria","b_colorado","b_phuket","b_washington")

for (ag in antigens_sero) {

  d0_col <- paste0("val_igg_d0_", ag)
  d7_col <- paste0("val_igg_d7_", ag)

  d0_col <- str_replace_all(d0_col, "\\.", "_")
  d7_col <- str_replace_all(d7_col, "\\.", "_")

  fc_col <- paste0("val.igg_fc_", ag)
  sc_col <- paste0("val.igg_seroconvert_", ag)
  hi_col <- paste0("val.igg_d0_hightiter_flag_", ag)

  if (all(c(d0_col, d7_col) %in% names(sero_wide))) {

    sero_wide <- sero_wide |>
      mutate(
        !!fc_col := if_else(
          is.na(.data[[d0_col]]) | .data[[d0_col]] == 0,
          NA_real_,
          .data[[d7_col]] / .data[[d0_col]]
        ),

        !!sc_col := case_when(
          is.na(.data[[fc_col]]) ~ NA,
          .data[[fc_col]] >= 4   ~ TRUE,
          TRUE                  ~ FALSE
        ),

        !!hi_col := if_else(
          is.na(.data[[d0_col]]),
          NA,
          !is.na(.data[[d0_col]]) &
          .data[[d0_col]] > quantile(.data[[d0_col]], 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      )
  }
}

cat("\nSerology wide dimensions:", nrow(sero_wide), "x", ncol(sero_wide), "\n")
```



```{r}
# HAI

# filtering to flu year 1
hai_y1 <- flu_hai |>
  filter(
    vaccine.year == "2019-2020",
    sample.daysSinceFirstVisit %in% c(0, 7, 8, 9, 10),
    msd.antigenName != "BSA"
  )

cat("\nHAI Year 1 rows:", nrow(hai_y1), "\n")
cat("Subjects:", n_distinct(hai_y1$subject.subjectGuid), "\n")
cat("Antigens:", n_distinct(hai_y1$msd.antigenName), "\n")
```

```{r}
# CV greater than 20%
hai_y1 <- hai_y1 |>
  mutate(hai_cv_flag = case_when(
    is.na(msd.signalNormPercentCV) ~ NA,
    msd.signalNormPercentCV > 20   ~ TRUE,
    TRUE                          ~ FALSE
  ))

cat("HAI CV flags (>20%):", sum(hai_y1$hai_cv_flag == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```


```{r}
# addressing multiple post-vaccine timepoints
hai_pre <- hai_y1 |> filter(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit == 0)

hai_post <- hai_y1 |>
  filter(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit != 0) |>
  group_by(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid, msd.antigenName) |>
  arrange(sample.daysSinceFirstVisit) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
# pivoting to wide

# hai pre
hai_pre <- hai_pre |> distinct(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid, msd.antigenName, .keep_all = TRUE)

hai_pre_wide <- hai_pre |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid),
    names_from = msd.antigenName,
    values_from = c(msd.percentNormInhibition, hai_cv_flag),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{msd.antigenName}",
    values_fn = first
  ) |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("val.hai_d0_", str_remove(.x, "msd_percent_norm_inhibition_")),
              .cols = starts_with("msd_percent_norm_inhibition_")) |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("val.hai_cv_flag_d0_", str_remove(.x, "hai_cv_flag_")),
              .cols = starts_with("hai_cv_flag_"))

# hai post
hai_post <- hai_post |> distinct(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid, msd.antigenName, .keep_all = TRUE)

hai_post_wide <- hai_post |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(subject.subjectGuid, sample.sampleKitGuid),
    names_from = msd.antigenName,
    values_from = c(msd.percentNormInhibition, hai_cv_flag),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{msd.antigenName}",
    values_fn = first
  ) |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("val.hai_d7_", str_remove(.x, "msd_percent_norm_inhibition_")),
              .cols = starts_with("msd_percent_norm_inhibition_")) |>
  rename_with(~ paste0("val.hai_cv_flag_d7_", str_remove(.x, "hai_cv_flag_")),
              .cols = starts_with("hai_cv_flag_"))

hai_wide <- hai_pre_wide |>
  full_join(
    hai_post_wide,
    by = c("subject_subject_guid", "sample_sample_kit_guid")
  )

cat("\nHAI wide dimensions:", nrow(hai_wide), "x", ncol(hai_wide), "\n")
```


```{r}
# joining serology and hai
validation <- sero_wide |>
  full_join(
    hai_wide,
    by = c("subject_subject_guid", "sample_sample_kit_guid")
  ) |>
  distinct(subject_subject_guid, sample_sample_kit_guid, .keep_all = TRUE)

validation_dedup <- validation |>
  group_by(subject_subject_guid) |>
  summarise(
    sample_sample_kit_guid = first(sample_sample_kit_guid),

    across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(where(is.logical), ~ any(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nValidation join dimensions:", nrow(validation), "x", ncol(validation), "\n")
cat("Subjects in final validation set:", n_distinct(validation$subject_subject_guid), "\n")
```


```{r}
cat("\n=== JOIN KEY CHECKS ===\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(validation), "\n")
cat("Subjects:", n_distinct(validation_dedup$subject_subject_guid), "\n")

cat("\nMissing subjectGuid:", sum(is.na(validation_dedup$subject_subject_guid)), "\n")
cat("Missing sampleKitGuid:", sum(is.na(validation_dedup$sample_sample_kit_guid)), "\n")
cat("Duplicate subjects:", sum(duplicated(validation_dedup$subject_subject_guid)), "\n")

# Missingness on key validation targets
val_target_cols <- names(validation_dedup)[str_starts(names(validation), "val")]

miss_val <- naniar::miss_var_summary(validation_dedup |> select(all_of(val_target_cols)))
print(miss_val, n = Inf)
```


```{r}
# dropping columns that are 100% missing
cols_to_drop <- miss_summary |>
  filter(pct_miss == 100) |>
  pull(variable)

cat("Dropping 100% missing columns:", paste(cols_to_drop, collapse = ", "), "\n")

baseline <- baseline |> select(-any_of(cols_to_drop))
```


```{r}
write.csv(
  validation,
  "~/Desktop/Capstone Data/Flu Vaccine Serology and HAI/flu_response_validation.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nSaved: flu_response_validation.csv\n")
cat("Final dimensions:", nrow(validation), "x", ncol(validation), "\n")
```
